honesty_notes: static/templates/** and src/content/*.ts contain Electron API example fiddles shipped as application data: they are rendered and run inside the fiddle sandbox, never executed as Electron Fiddle's own process code. This extractor version has no scan-scope mechanism, so their constructs (most of the ipc_channel and window_lifecycle populations, and parts of other kinds) are included in the 401 elements. Counts are therefore an upper bound on app-slice semantics; no attempt was made to subtract them post hoc, since that would be unauditable.

All elements carry status `extracted` (or extractor `undetermined` for 29 computed requires) only: the representability figures in `assessment` come from the separate disparate-assess run against Goya capabilities and include no translation claims.

The 156 assessed `undetermined` elements include hooks and event handlers classified by scanner limits (occurrence sites, not data-flow); this is programme debt of the extractor, not evidence of missing Goya capabilities.
Extraction completeness is bounded by the declared scanner limits; a full-parser extractor revision or a scan-scope mechanism would be a new extractor version, not a silent rewrite.
